name: IK-Generator
description: Automates French professional mileage allowances: routes, official 2026 scale, Excel export for accounting/tax. Founded Mar 2025, France. Solo. ~80 users (founder-stated). Listed for sale (codebase, domain, SEO site, GA + Paddle). Pricing: €99/year per account via Paddle.

mentions.evidence: ~$689 MRR, 75 active subscriptions, ~$111 L30, ~$12,707 all-time. Founder-stated ~$9k L12 / 94% margin. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~05:50 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: Wrap one country's statutory calculator, sell the PDF/Excel, then flip or expand to the next barème.

whyItPrints: Every FR self-employed driver, sales rep, and agent still owes a barème spreadsheet. One annual tax chore × SEO = quiet recurring cash with ~94% margin (founder-stated).
whyThisMatters:
Self-employed people in France still have to turn driving into a mileage-allowance table the accountant will accept. IK-Generator does that chore. You enter a starting address, pick the period, and it applies the official 2026 scale and exports Excel.

There is a generator mode that builds trips from one address, and a manual mode for a return trip or a round. A database of more than 17 million addresses cuts retyping. Recurring destinations can live in an address book. A history keeps the trips, the calculations, and the exports.

They also offer a free simulator if you only want to test a number. The paid account is an annual plan through Paddle, and the listing is for sale with the codebase, the domain, and the site. The company is a solo shop in France, started in 2025.

You pay so the barème spreadsheet is already done.
